topic: Updating dataset with full year data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the `alex_test_1` dataset for Brazil and Campinas. Currently, the data is only available from April to the day before yesterday. The total traffic has not changed, but changes in 'VA' (presumably a metric) have altered the impression count.

The process requires updating aggregates carefully because it involves sessions, which is time-consuming (estimated one or two days).
To speed up the process, someone suggested that [p1] should populate the full year of data into `alex_test_1`.
decisions: The dataset needs to be updated with a full year of historical data for Brazil and Campinas.
action_items: [p1] needs to populate the full year of data into the `alex_test_1` dataset.
